capture.object: John Guest PP1208E 1/4-inch black polypropylene bulkhead union with captured nut
capture.preparation: Sprayed, putty-mounted, focused and rotated by Derek.

end_axis_fit.selection: Initial |X| 13..24 mm; table height >16 mm; radius <9 mm; |normal.X|<0.3; outward radial normal >0.8; every third point

selection: Table height >17 mm; initial axial X -23..19 mm; radius <13.5 mm. No CAD-distance rejection.

body_hex.method: Six-fold normal clustering; regular hex fit with equal weight per exposed flat and soft-L1 loss; molded marks retained in model comparison.

nut_hex.method: Six-fold normal clustering; regular hex fit with equal weight per exposed flat and soft-L1 loss; molded marks retained in model comparison.

limits: Paint thickness and absolute optical scale are not independently calibrated.
Putty-hidden lower sectors continue the fitted turned and hexagonal forms.
The barrel uses a smooth thread-crest envelope; grooves and hidden engagement are omitted.
Collet finger slots and molded marks are omitted; the bore and mouth bevels are display geometry.
Exposed release-face planes are representative coaxial datums; captured free collets may tilt.
The captured nut position is separate from the installed clamp stack.
